meaning:
1) whispering, charming
1a) serpent-charming
1b) charms, amulets (worn by women)
1c) whisper (of prayer)

elsewhere.note: If the snake bites before it is charmed, then is there no profit for the charmer’s tongue.
the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.
“For, behold, I will send serpents, adders among you, which will not be charmed; and they will bite you,” says Yahweh.
